title: Module 4: Beyond ADDIE — Comparing ID Process Models
description: Compare Dick and Carey, the Kemp model, Smith and Ragan, SAM, and Agile/Lean ID, then learn when to choose each.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish at least four ID process models by their distinguishing emphasis
Match a project's risk, uncertainty, and audience to an appropriate model choice
Explain why mature designers combine an alignment model with a delivery model

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
